evidence.note: Established reference S3/NC baseline via evaluator, and tracked exact best-so-far scores per run (yeast Run 3 S3=0.559346 NC=0.3001), showing a maintained score ledger against targets.
Repeated sleep+tail log monitoring of parallel optimization jobs during long stochastic runs — logs the objective over iterations rather than running blind.
Killed still-running jobs early once finished runs already had better scores — used live monitoring to reallocate compute.

Tracked DM-HS best-so-far progression (0.3073→0.3112→0.3122→0.3131→0.3131) across reheating rounds, always deploying/re-evaluating the best; clearly knew DM-HS still missed the 0.32 bar while yeast was done.
Weakness: interpreted a clear plateau (~0.311-0.313) as being 'on a direct trajectory to cross 0.32' repeatedly, failing to diagnose genuine convergence — keeps it below the top anchor.

reasoning: The agent logged the objective over iterations, monitored parallel runs periodically, maintained an explicit best-so-far ledger per deliverable, and used that information to kill/deploy/reheat and to know which file still fell short — squarely matching the level-8 anchor. It falls short of 10 because it repeatedly misread a hard plateau at ~0.313 as continued progress toward 0.32 rather than detecting convergence, so it did not cleanly distinguish genuine plateau from slow progress.
